## Teaching

I teach across a range of modules in biological sciences, with a particular focus on genetics, genomics, molecular biology, statistics, and data science. My teaching materials are designed to support practical, research-connected learning.

- Data Science
- Genetics
- Molecular Biology & Genetics
- Genomics
- Microbiology
- Field Ecology

## Recommended resources

### R tools and data visualisation

* [free icons from fontawesome](https://fontawesome.com/v5/search?m=free) and the [`{fontawesome}`](https://github.com/rstudio/fontawesome) R package for adding icons to slides, websites, and reports
* [A ggplot2 Tutorial for Beautiful Plotting in R](https://cedricscherer.netlify.app/2019/08/05/a-ggplot2-tutorial-for-beautiful-plotting-in-r/)
* [Beautifully Annotated: Enhancing your ggplots with Text](https://www.cararthompson.com/talks/rl-cambridge-beautifully-annotated/)

### Reporting, presentation, and learning materials

* [Quarto](https://quarto.org/)
* [Meet xaringan: Making slides in R Markdown](https://arm.rbind.io/slides/xaringan.html#1)
* [Sharing Your `xaringan` Slides](https://www.garrickadenbuie.com/blog/sharing-xaringan-slides/)
* [The Big Book of R](https://www.bigbookofr.com/)
* [Mastering Shiny](https://mastering-shiny.org/index.html)
* [Happy Git and GitHub for the useR](https://happygitwithr.com/)
* [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.had.co.nz/)
* [W3Schools](https://www.w3schools.com/default.asp)

### Communities and biosciences resources

* [Biosciences Teaching and Education Research Zenodo Page](https://zenodo.org/communities/uea-bio-teaching)
* [R-volutionary Biology](https://ueabio.github.io/Rvolutionary-Biology/)
* [Skills Community of Practice](https://www.skillscop.com/)

[See the extended reading list](myresources.qmd){.section-link}
